4857:soul:2044.reviewedBy: Codex explicit current successful attack count and source reentry review
4857:soul:2044.rationale: 当前在场奇偶攻击命中计数、面板附粉和首次致死保1前缀真实实现；两防降低与等量回复歧义保留Q-4857-001，不用多精灵延期豁免。原文明示登场之后，真实再次登场的计数延续或重置须第二阶段核实，不擅自宣称来源规定重置。
4857:soul:2044.singleBehavior: 成功攻击命中奇偶交替按防御/特防面板50%附粉，正零负能力等级基数一致；MISS、整招无效、控制及属性招不计，已命中零红和附粉免疫仍计；首次正致死伤害保1的HP/完整结算伤害前缀已验证，随后未核实的降低与回血明确报错，回合不提交。

success.name: 4857真实2044奇偶命中分别按防御和特防面板50%附粉，能力等级正零负基数均不变
4857真实2044未命中、整招无效、无法行动与属性招不计攻击命中；零红与附粉免疫仍计次
4857真实2044首次致死保1前缀保留完整伤害与实际HP损失，后续降低回血明确待答；已消费不再次保命
success.assertion:
for(const type of['attack','fixed','percent','true']){const s=make({move:10780,index:-1,soul:true,hp:200,bStats:{atk:9999}});let seen=false;assert.throws(()=>observe((event,c)=>{if(event==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1&&type!=='attack')c.hurt(c.t,500,'致死测试',type);if(event==='damageTaken'&&c.a.side===0){assert.equal(c.a.hp,1);assert.equal(c.hpLoss,199);assert.ok(c.settledDamage>=200);assert.equal(c.a.soulState.phalanx2044.survivalUsed,true);seen=true;}},()=>turn(s,10780,type==='attack'?10127:20117),true),/Q-4857-001/);assert.equal(seen,true);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,200,'未核实后缀使整回合拒绝提交，不冒充完整生存分支完成');}
 const used=make({move:10780,index:-1,soul:true,hp:100,bStats:{atk:9999}});used.fighters[0].soulState.phalanx2044={hits:0,survivalUsed:true,pendingSurvival:false};turn(used,10780,10127);assert.equal(used.fighters[0].hp,0);const zero=make({move:10780,index:-1,soul:true,hp:200});timer(zero,0,'攻击伤害免疫');turn(zero,10780,10127);assert.equal(zero.fighters[0].soulState.phalanx2044.survivalUsed,false);assert.equal(require('../local-species.cjs').save(source).saved,false);
